bullets.text: Apple Wallet's New Feature - iOS 27 will allow users to create custom passes for unsupported tickets.
DeepMind Workers Unionize - Employees aim to prevent AI tech from aiding military operations.
Microsoft Ditches MSN Feed - Windows 11 widgets will hide the MSN news feed by default.
Nvidia's Job Creation Claim - CEO asserts AI is generating numerous jobs, countering fears of unemployment.
Fervo Energy's IPO Plans - Geothermal startup aims to raise up to $1.3 billion in its initial public offering.
CopyFail Bug Alert - A severe vulnerability in Linux systems is actively exploited by hackers.
Elon Musk's Twitter Settlement - Musk agrees to a $1.5 million penalty without admitting wrongdoing.
Cerebras IPO on the Horizon - AI chipmaker plans to raise up to $3.5 billion in its upcoming IPO.
AI Models Drive App Growth - Image AI releases are generating significantly more downloads than chatbots.
DoorDash Enhances Merchant Tools - New AI features streamline onboarding and improve dish presentation.
